article: Personal movie watchlist and viewing checklist
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared the 42 checklist entries in order and their watched/unwatched status; corrected duplicate dates and clarified the date represented by the personal viewing checklist.
findings: Removed the duplicated future date (2026-09-24), restored the repository’s original publication date (2023-04-17), and recorded the review date as lastmod in all 13 editions.
Verified that every edition contains the same 42 works in the same order and exactly matches the Japanese watched/unwatched checkbox pattern (14 marked watched).
Added a localized note explaining that checkboxes report the author’s status when the list was published in April 2023 and may be outdated.

post/映画TODOリスト/index.en.md.summary: Compared all 42 movie and anime checklist entries with the Japanese source; matched every watched/unwatched checkbox and clarified that the personal checklist reflects its April 2023 publication date.

meaning.note: Compared all 42 checklist items and checked statuses in the complete Japanese article and twelve translations. Kept each item in the same position and added the original publication date so readers can interpret the personal viewing checkboxes.

terminology.note: Compared the translated movie/anime names and preserved the original distinction between watched [x] and unwatched [ ].

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or formulas.

code.note: The article contains no code or commands.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The 42 watch-status entries reflect the author’s checklist as published in April 2023; the author’s current viewing status was not independently confirmed.
Film titles can differ by region and distributor; translations identify the corresponding works but do not claim to reproduce every local release title.
